name: Hunt Par Force
source:
The hunt par force was a ritualistic style of hunting favored by medieval European nobility. Groups of hunters and their dogs would chase their prey to exhaustion before closing in for the kill. 

A similar manner of persistence hunting is observed in wolf packs.

[From [url=https://goblincat.itch.io/hunt-par-force]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
强力狩猎是一种深受中世纪欧洲贵族喜爱的仪式性狩猎方式。成群结队的猎人和他们的猎犬会追逐猎物直至精疲力尽，然后才逼近猎物。

在狼群中也观察到类似的持续狩猎方式。

[来自[url=https://goblincat.itch.io/hunt-par-force]itch.io[/url]]
